units.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure
units.text: 1. Overcharging state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) for products, goods or services, or maximum prices (tariffs, rates, charges, fees and the like); exceeding established price mark-ups (margins) on prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); or, for tobacco articles or nicotine-containing products, exceeding the maximum retail price indicated by the manufacturer on each consumer package (pack), except in the cases provided for by Part 4 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.6

units.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, twice the excess revenue from sales of goods (work or services) resulting from the unlawful overstatement of state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.6 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure
units.text: 2. Undercharging state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) for products, goods or services, or maximum prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); reducing established price mark-ups (margins) on prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); violating the established procedure for regulating prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); or any other violation of the established pricing procedure —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.6

units.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundred thousand roubles.
